_comment: The GEMM half of a runtime mode-switch run. ONE entry on purpose: the switch, not the tiling, is what is under test. It carries NO "schedule" — the suite row (or the --case target) says a switch is being run, so this stays an ordinary shape any other case can reuse. K = 16 fills one contraction pass for every config in 5.toroidal_dual_mode.json and 6.toroidal_dual_mode_acc.json, which is the precondition that makes the switch safe: a partly loaded stationary chain would leave the previous mode's values in the unwritten slots.
